Here is a complete summary of everything found:

---

## 1. `src/pages/Chat.tsx` (715 lines)

The Chat page is a full-featured streaming chat UI. Key parts:

- **`MermaidDiagram`** — renders Mermaid diagrams from fenced code blocks using `mermaid.render()`, with stale-result protection via a render ID ref.
- **`ChartBlock`** — renders Chart.js charts (bar/line/pie/doughnut/radar/polarArea) from `chart` / `chartjs` / auto-detected `js`/`json` blocks, with a Chart/Source toggle.
- **`markdownComponents`** — full custom ReactMarkdown component map covering code, headings, tables, lists, blockquotes, links, etc.
- **`ProductSelector`** — queries `/customer-registry/products` via `useQuery` and renders a `<select>` to scope the chat context.
- **`MessageBubble`** — renders user (right-aligned, primary color bubble) and assistant (left-aligned, card bubble with Markdown) messages.
- **`Chat` (main component)** — manages `messages`, `streamingContent`, `isStreaming`, `activeTool`, `selectedProductId`, `input`, and `conversationId` (a stable UUID ref). The `conversationId` is generated once on mount and never changes.

---

## 2. Chat API call mechanism

The chat call in `sendMessage` uses the **native `fetch` API** (not axios), because it needs to consume a streaming `text/event-stream` response:

```491:503:src/pages/Chat.tsx
        const response = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/chat`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            Accept: 'text/event-stream',
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            message: text.trim(),
            ...(selectedProductId ? { productId: selectedProductId } : {}),
            conversationId: conversationId.current,
          }),
        })
```

The SSE stream is consumed manually with a `ReadableStream` reader + `TextDecoder`, parsing `data:` lines as JSON `ChatEvent` objects (`text`, `tool_start`, `tool_end`, `done`, `error`). The token is refreshed just before each request via `refreshToken()` from `@/lib/keycloak`.

All other API calls (products list, etc.) use the **axios instance** from `src/lib/api.ts`.

---

## 3. `src/lib/api.ts`

A thin axios wrapper:
- `baseURL` = `VITE_API_URL`
- Request interceptor: calls `refreshToken()` then injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
- Response interceptor: on `401`, calls `login()` to redirect to Keycloak.

---

## 4. `src/config/applicationMenu.tsx`

Defines `NavigationMenuItem` interface and the `ApplicationMenuItems()` factory function that returns the full menu tree:

- **Top-level items**: Dashboard (`/`), Jobs (`/jobs`), Plans (`/plans`), Chat (`/chat`)
- **Metrics** (parent with children): Quality Reports, Review Metrics, AI Stats
- **Settings** (parent with children): Repositories, Hooks, Prompts, Memories, Customers, Knowledge Index, System

---

## 5. `src/main.tsx`

Sets up TanStack Router with all routes nested under a `layoutRoute` (which renders `MainLayout`), plus a standalone `/access-denied` route. All page imports are listed here. Routes:

```
/                  → Dashboard
/jobs              → Jobs
/jobs/new          → NewJob
/jobs/$id          → JobDetail
/settings/repos    → RepoSettings
/settings/hooks    → Hooks
/settings/prompts  → Prompts
/plans             → Plans
/plans/new         → NewPlan
/plans/$id         → PlanDetail
/metrics/quality   → QualityReports
/metrics/reviews   → ReviewMetrics
/stats             → AiStats
/settings/memories → Memories
/settings/system   → SystemSettings
/settings/knowledge→ KnowledgeIndex
/settings/customers→ CustomerRegistry
/chat              → Chat
/access-denied     → AccessDenied
```

Auth is handled in `RootComponent` via `authStore`; it redirects to `/access-denied` if not authenticated after initialization.

---

## 6. `src/types/api.ts`

Contains all API type definitions. Chat-specific types at the bottom:

```358:376:src/types/api.ts
export interface ChatRequest {
  message: string
  productId?: string
  conversationId?: string
}

export interface ChatEvent {
  type: 'text' | 'tool_start' | 'tool_end' | 'done' | 'error'
  text?: string
  tool?: string
  error?: string
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string
  role: 'user' | 'assistant'
  content: string
}
```

Other types cover: `JobStatus`/`JobType`/`JobStatusResponse`, `RepoSettings`, `AutomationHook`, `PromptTemplate`, `ExecutionPlan`/`PlanPhase`/`PlanStep`, `QualityReport`, `AiCallSummary`/`AiCallRecord`, `ReviewMetrics`, `MemoryEntry`, `CustomerConfig`/`ProductConfig` (full customer registry shape), `SystemSetting`, `KnowledgeStatEntry`/`KnowledgeSearchResult`.

---

## 7. Sidebar / Navigation components

Three files make up the sidebar:

**`src/components/layout/SideBar.tsx`** — collapsible sidebar (58px collapsed → 224px on hover, or full-width on mobile). Shows logo, `Menu` component, and user avatar/logout at the bottom. Hover-to-expand is disabled in mobile expanded mode.

**`src/components/navigation/menu/Menu.tsx`** — renders `NavigationMenuItem[]` recursively. Parent items toggle their children with a chevron; leaf items call `item.onClick`. Active items get a distinct background color.

**`src/components/layout/MainLayout.tsx`** — the shell that glues everything together. On desktop: fixed sidebar + scrollable `<main>`. On mobile: top bar with hamburger + overlay drawer sidebar + content below the header.

---

```
src/

│   ├── VersionBadge.tsx
│   └── layout/
│       ├── MainLayout.tsx         # App shell (desktop sidebar + mobile header)
│       ├── PageHeader.tsx         # Reusable page title/subtitle/actions header
│       └── SideBar.tsx            # Collapsible navigation sidebar
│   └── navigation/
│       └── menu/
│           └── Menu.tsx           # Recursive nav menu renderer
├── config/
│   └── applicationMenu.tsx        # Menu item definitions + NavigationMenuItem type
├── lib/
│   ├── api.ts                     # Axios instance with auth interceptors
│   ├── keycloak.ts                # Keycloak init, token, refresh, login, logout
│   ├── route-guards.ts            # (Route guard helpers)
│   └── version.ts                 # App version utility
├── pages/
│   ├── AccessDenied.tsx
│   ├── AiStats.tsx
│   ├── Chat.tsx                   # Streaming chat page
│   ├── CustomerRegistry.tsx
│   ├── Dashboard.tsx
│   ├── Hooks.tsx
│   ├── JobDetail.tsx
│   ├── Jobs.tsx
│   ├── KnowledgeIndex.tsx
│   ├── Memories.tsx
│   ├── NewJob.tsx
│   ├── NewPlan.tsx
│   ├── PlanDetail.tsx
│   ├── Plans.tsx
│   ├── Prompts.tsx
│   ├── QualityReports.tsx
│   ├── RepoSettings.tsx
│   ├── ReviewMetrics.tsx
│   └── SystemSettings.tsx
├── store/
│   └── auth-store.ts              # TanStack Store for auth state + Keycloak helpers
├── styles/
│   ├── base.css
│   ├── dark.css
│   ├── fonts.css
│   ├── index.css
│   ├── light.css
│   └── tailwind.css
├── types/
│   └── api.ts                     # All API request/response TypeScript types
├── main.tsx                       # Router setup + ReactDOM render entry point
└── vite-env.d.ts
```

There is **no dedicated conversation list / history sidebar** — `conversationId` is a UUID generated fresh on each page mount (stored in a `useRef`), so there is currently no persistence or listing of past conversations in the UI.
